figures.title: Five-dimensional profiles
figures.description: Six fixed-setting pentagons against ordinary standard. The band vertex uses the documented degraded band, never the most favorable band.

figures.title: Suite effect sizes and confidence intervals
figures.description: Mean-return effects, reliability, catastrophe reduction and consistency, including the Drawer TD3 trade-off and KL-on versus KL-off.

figures.title: Consistency by deployment severity
figures.description: Separate mild, moderate and severe win fractions. Severe-level coverage and uncertainty stay visible.

figures.title: Reliability-band decomposition
figures.description: Width-weighted band contributions sum to total reliability change. Stronger near-nominal performance is not automatically a rescue of collapsed policies.

figures.title: Nominal competence and deployment failure
figures.description: Separates nominal learning failure from shifted return-threshold failure within each method's competent subset; descriptive, not a causal decomposition.
